title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1972-09-15

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard fragment that captures a smoking Truckin' and an electrifying Other One highlighted by Keith's out‑of‑this‑world keyboards.
ai_review.review: The short 30‑minute excerpt delivers high‑energy jams, especially the Truckin' > The Other One sequence where Keith’s moog‑flavored keys steal the show. Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear mix and superb transfer, even though they lament the missing remainder of the concert.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers rate 4–5 stars, praising both the performance (especially the jams) and the pristine soundboard mix; consistent enthusiastic feedback across six reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is described as crystal‑clear with excellent transfer; no major artifacts noted, though the recording is only a fragment of the full show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fragment captures late‑second‑set material with seamless jam flow; reviewers wish for the rest of the set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work is highlighted as 'amazing syncopation', moog‑like textures, and demented soloing that adds a new dimension to the jams.
